description: Repairs r-txn-1b/ddl-second-workspace-sees-uncommitted: B's catalog and read ran with no Idle, and A's own view of X was not read, so invisibility could not be separated from caching. On r-txn-1b-main-accdb: owner A = Workspaces(0) with OpenDatabase(main, writable); owner B = CreateWorkspace('second', dbUseJet) with its own writable OpenDatabase; one STA. A: BeginTrans; CREATE TABLE X (ID LONG primary key); INSERT INTO X (ID) VALUES (1) (dbFailOnError); A reads SELECT ID FROM X. B: refreshed TableDefs names and SELECT ID FROM X as is, then after DBEngine.Idle(dbRefreshCache), then again after a 7 s pause. A: DBEngine.Errors right before and after Rollback; A reads X. B: the same three observations. Close both; the catalog through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
